metadata.title: त्रिपुरी देबबर्मा समुदाय की धन और धान की देवी | Religious belief of Debbarma Community in Tripura
metadata.description:
The Goria Puja is a traditional festival celebrated by the Debbarma community, which is one of the major tribes in the Indian state of Tripura. The festival is usually observed in the month of April or May, and it lasts for several days.
During the Goria Puja, the Debbarma people worship their deity, Goria, who is believed to be the protector of their community. The festival involves a lot of rituals, including singing and dancing, offerings of food and drink to the deity and the sacrifice of animals like goats and buffaloes.

Here is a ground report on how the families of this tribe perform this puja.
